hook.hook: Nobody tells you what to do with a glut of Brussels sprouts

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you what to do with a glut of Brussels sprouts

My dad always showed me the value of using up every harvest. If you want to know what to do with a glut of Brussels sprouts, try roasting them with olive oil and balsamic vinegar for a caramelised flavour. You can also blanch small sprouts for three minutes and freeze them for up to 12 months.

Check your local frost dates.

hook.hook: Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

I plant my largest outer cloves from October to November in full sun. Here is how to grow garlic in the UK without letting heavy soil rot your bulbs. Once harvested, dry them in a warm, airy place for two to three weeks so they keep for up to nine months.

Do not store raw garlic in oil at room temperature, as there is a risk of botulism.

Check your local frost dates.

Don't waste your coriander. Make Fresh Coriander & Mint Chutney instead
